column3: Outdated: the ruling (published 2006-02-01, Guildpact) applied the Two-Headed Giant combat rules of its time, under which each player on the active team was an attacking player (CR 606.7a of the CR current as of 2006-02-01) and no rule picked one of them for the ability of a blocking creature, so its controller chose; the CR current as of 2007-02-01 (Planar Chaos) wrote that into 606.7a ("Any one-shot effect or characteristic-setting ability that refers to the 'defending player' refers to one specific defending player, not to both of the defending players. The controller of the effect or of the object with the characteristic-setting ability chooses which one the spell or ability refers to. The same is true for any one-shot effect that refers to the 'attacking player.'"), still 810.7b in the CR effective 2018-01-19 ("Any one-shot effect that refers to the 'defending player' refers to one specific defending player, not to both of the defending players. The controller of the effect chooses which one the spell or ability refers to at the time the effect is applied. The same is true for any one-shot effect that refers to the 'attacking player.'"). The CR effective 2017-06-05 added 805.10c for the shared team turns option (absent from the CR effective 2017-04-28; "If an ability of a blocking creature refers to an attacking player ... the attacking player it's referring to is the player who controls that attacking creature"), and the CR effective 2018-04-27 (Dominaria) made Two-Headed Giant use it (810.7: "The Two-Headed Giant variant uses the combat rules for the shared team turns option (see rule 805.10). This is a change from previous rules."; archived CR texts, github.com/pit142857/mtg-cr). Souls of the Faultless is a blocking creature when it's dealt combat damage, so the attacking player its ability refers to is the controller of the attacking creature it blocks, not a player of its controller's choice. Tested in tests/rulings/r_p049_combat.rs (souls_of_the_faultless_in_two_headed_giant_drains_the_controller_of_the_creature_it_blocks); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
